newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas shares close at year-end record.
newsitem.headline: Caracas shares close at year-end record.

text.p: Caracas stocks reached record levels for the second consecutive day but in slow trade with investors already anticipating 1997, traders said.
The market's leading 19-share index .IBCu finished up 0.45 percent at a record 6,443.77 points.
According to preliminary figures, a total 14.52 million shares were exchanged, worth a mere 2.87 billion bolivars ($6.04 million), with nearly a third being large cross-trades.
"The market, both local and foreign investors, is already looking ahead to January and taking positions," trader Freddy Zambrano said.
Most traders predicted a similar tendency over the holiday period and in days to come as investors table on a steady Venezuelan economic recovery next year.
The Venezuelan stock exchange is shut Wednesday for Christmas. It reopens Thursday.
